units.text: Motivation: limitations of vanilla SSMs – they ignore irregular timespans and are vulnerable to input noise

Standard state-space models assume uniform timesteps and therefore ignore the irregular timespans that characterize real-world interaction sequences, and their state update provides no explicit mechanism to suppress unreliable or noisy transitions.
These two limitations motivate the timespan-aware and noise-robust design choices that follow.
